Bundled terminal rendering libraries for the account sign-in panel.
pyte 0.8.2 (LGPL-3.0-or-later), wcwidth 0.2.13 (MIT).
Unmodified Python modules from their PyPI wheels; licenses are included.
https://github.com/selectel/pyte
https://github.com/jquast/wcwidth
These modules are used only by accounts.py. No package installation is needed.
